verses.text: Di book of di genealogy of Jesus Christ, David pikin, Abraham pikin:
Abraham born Isaac. Isaac born Jacob. Jacob born Judah and im brothers.
Judah born Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez born Hezron. Hezron born Ram.
Ram born Amminadab. Amminadab born Nahshon. Nahshon born Salmon.
Salmon born Boaz by Rahab. Boaz born Obed by Ruth. Obed born Jesse.
Jesse born King David. David born Solomon by di woman wey na Uriah wife before.
Solomon born Rehoboam. Rehoboam born Abijah. Abijah born Asa.
Asa born Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat born Joram. Joram born Uzziah.
Uzziah born Jotham. Jotham born Ahaz. Ahaz born Hezekiah.
Hezekiah born Manasseh. Manasseh born Amon. Amon born Josiah.
Josiah born Jechoniah and im brothers, for di time of di exile to Babylon.
After di exile to Babylon, Jechoniah born Shealtiel. Shealtiel born Zerubbabel.
Zerubbabel born Abiud. Abiud born Eliakim. Eliakim born Azor.
Azor born Sadoc. Sadoc born Achim. Achim born Eliud.
Eliud born Eleazar. Eleazar born Matthan. Matthan born Jacob.
Jacob born Joseph, di husband of Mary; from am dem born Jesus, wey dem dey call Christ.
So all di generations from Abraham to David na 14 generations; from David to di exile to Babylon na 14 generations; and from di carrying away to Babylon to Christ, na 14 generations.
Now di birth of Jesus Christ na like dis; because im mama, Mary, don dey engaged to Joseph, but before dem come together, dem find say e dey pregnant by Holy Spirit.
Joseph, im husband, wey na righteous man, and no want make am public example, plan to send am away secretly.

But as e dey think about dis things, look, angel of di Lord appear to am for dream, and talk say, “Joseph, David pikin, no fear to take Mary as your wife, because wetin don conceive inside am come from Holy Spirit.”
“E go give birth to son. You go call im name Jesus, because na im go save im people from dem sins.”
Now all dis one happen, so that wetin di Lord talk through di prophet go dey fulfilled, wey talk say,
“Look, di virgin go dey pregnant, and go give birth to son. Dem go call im name Immanuel;” wey mean, “God dey with us.”
Joseph rise from im sleep, and do as di angel of di Lord command am, and take im wife come stay with am;
and e no know am sexually until e don give birth to im first pikin, wey be son. E name am Jesus.
Now when dem born Jesus for Bethlehem of Judea for di days of King Herod, look, wise men from di east come to Jerusalem, and talk say,
“Wia di one dey wey dem born as King of di Jews? Because we see im star for di east, and we don come to worship am.”
When King Herod hear am, e dey troubled, and all Jerusalem with am.
E gather together all di chief priests and scribes of di people, and ask dem wia Christ go born.
Dem talk say to am, “For Bethlehem of Judea, because dem write am so through di prophet,”
“‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, no be di least among di princes of Judah at all: because from you go come out governor, wey go shepherd my people, Israel.’”
Den Herod call di wise men secretly, and learn from dem di exact time wey di star appear.
E send dem go Bethlehem, and talk say, “Go and search carefully for di young child. When una don find am, bring me word, so that I too go come and worship am.”
Dem hear di king, and go dem way; and look, di star wey dem see for di east dey go before dem, until e come and stand over wia di young child dey.
When dem see di star, dem rejoice with very great joy.
Dem enter di house and see di young child with Mary, im mama, and dem fall down and worship am. Dem open dem treasures, dem offer am gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
Dem don dey warned for dream say dem no suppose return to Herod, so dem return to dem own country by another way.

Now when dem don leave, look, angel of di Lord appear to Joseph for dream, and talk say, “Rise and take di young child and im mama, and run go Egypt, and stay for dat place until I tell you, because Herod go seek di young child to destroy am.”
E rise and take di young child and im mama for night, and go Egypt,
and dey for dat place until di death of Herod; so that wetin di Lord talk through di prophet go dey fulfilled, wey talk say, “From Egypt I call my son.”

Den Herod, when e see say di wise men don mock am, e dey very angry, and send people go kill all di male pikin dem wey dey Bethlehem and for all di surrounding countryside, from two years old and below, according to di time wey e don learn exactly from di wise men.
Den wetin dem talk through Jeremiah di prophet dey fulfilled, and e talk say,
“Dem hear voice for Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel dey weep for im pikin dem; and e refuse make dem comfort am, because dem no dey again.”
But when Herod die, look, angel of di Lord appear for dream to Joseph for Egypt, and talk say,
“Rise and take di young child and im mama, and go enter di land of Israel, because dem wey dey seek di young child life don die.”
E rise and take di young child and im mama, and come enter di land of Israel.
But when e hear say Archelaus dey reign over Judea for di place of im papa, Herod, e fear to go dia. Dem don warn am for dream, so e withdraw enter di region of Galilee,
and come live for one city wey dem dey call Nazareth; so that wetin dem talk through di prophets go dey fulfilled, say dem go call am Nazarene.
For dem days, John di Baptizer come, dey preach for di wilderness of Judea, and talk say,
“Repent, because Kingdom of Heaven don near!”
Because na dis man Isaiah di prophet talk about, wey talk say, “Di voice of one wey dey cry for di wilderness, ‘Make ready di way of di Lord. Make im paths straight.’”
Now John imself get clothing of camel hair, and leather belt for im waist. Im food na locusts and wild honey.
Den people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all di region around di Jordan come out to am.
E baptize dem for di Jordan, and dem dey confess dem sins.
But when e see plenty of di Pharisees and Sadducees dey come for im baptism, e talk say to dem, “Una pikin dem of vipers, na who warn una to run from di wrath wey dey come?”
“So bring forth fruit wey worthy of repentance!”
“No think for una heart say, ‘We get Abraham as our papa,’ because I tell una say God fit raise up pikin dem for Abraham from dis stones.”
“Even now di axe dey lie for di root of di trees. So every tree wey no bring forth good fruit dem go cut am down, and throw am into di fire.”
“I baptize una with water for repentance, but di one wey dey come after me strong pass me, wey I no worthy to carry im shoes. E go baptize una with Holy Spirit and with fire,”
“wey im winnowing fork dey im hand, and e go clean im threshing floor well. E go gather im wheat enter di barn, but di chaff e go burn with fire wey no fit quench.”
Den Jesus come from Galilee to di Jordan to John, so that John go baptize am.
But John try to stop am, and talk say, “I need say you baptize me, and you come to me?”
But Jesus answer, and talk say to am, “Allow am now, because na fitting way dis be for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Den e allow am.
Jesus, when dem baptize am, come up straight from di water: and look, di heavens open to am. E see God Spirit dey descend like dove, and dey come on am.
Look, voice from di heavens talk say, “Dis na my beloved Pikin, wey I dey well pleased with.”
Den di Spirit lead Jesus go up enter di wilderness so that di devil go tempt am.
When e don fast 40 days and 40 nights, e dey hungry afterward.
Di tempter come and talk say to am, “If you na God Pikin, command say dis stones become bread.”
But e answer, “Dem write am, ‘Man no go live by bread alone, but by every word wey dey come out from di mouth of God.’”
Den di devil take am enter di holy city. E set am on di pinnacle of di temple,

and talk say to am, “If you na God Pikin, throw yourself down, because dem write am, ‘E go give im angels charge about you.’ and, ‘For dem hands dem go carry you up, so that you no go hit your foot for stone.’”
Jesus talk say to am, “Again, dem write am, ‘You no go test di Lord your God.’”
Again, di devil take am go very high mountain, and show am all di kingdoms of di world, and dem glory.
E talk say to am, “I go give you all dis things, if you go fall down and worship me.”
Den Jesus talk say to am, “Get behind me, Satan! Because dem write am, ‘You go worship di Lord your God, and na only im you go serve.’”
Den di devil leave am, and look, angels come and serve am.
Now when Jesus hear say dem don hand John over, e withdraw go Galilee.
E leave Nazareth, come live for Capernaum, wey dey by di sea, for di region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
so that wetin dem talk through Isaiah di prophet go dey fulfilled, wey talk say,
“Di land of Zebulun and di land of Naphtali, toward di sea, beyond di Jordan, Galilee of di nations,”
“di people wey sit for darkness see great light, to dem wey sit for di region and shadow of death, light don dawn.”
From dat time, Jesus begin to preach, and to talk say, “Repent, because Kingdom of Heaven don near.”
As e dey walk by di sea of Galilee, e see two brothers, Simon wey dem dey call Peter, and Andrew, im brother, dey throw net enter di sea, because dem na fishermen.
E talk say to dem, “Follow me, and I go make una fishers of men.”
Dem leave dem nets immediately and follow am.
As e dey go from dat place, e see two other brothers, James, Zebedee pikin, and John, im brother, for di boat with Zebedee, dem papa, dey mend dem nets, and e call dem.
Dem leave di boat and dem papa immediately, and follow am.
Jesus dey go round all Galilee, dey teach for dem synagogues, dey preach Good News of di Kingdom, and dey heal every disease and every sickness among di people.
Di report about am spread enter all Syria. Dem bring to am all wey sick, wey various diseases and torments dey trouble, wey get evil spirits, epileptics, and paralytics; and e heal dem.
Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond di Jordan follow am.
When e see di multitudes, e go up on di mountain. When e sit down, im disciples come to am.
E open im mouth and teach dem, and talk say,
“Blessed na dem wey poor for spirit, because Kingdom of Heaven na dem own.”
“Blessed na dem wey mourn, because dem go dey comforted.”
“Blessed na dem wey gentle, because dem go inherit di earth.”
“Blessed na dem wey dey hunger and thirst for righteousness, because dem go dey filled.”
“Blessed na dem wey show mercy, because dem go receive mercy.”
“Blessed na dem wey pure for heart, because dem go see God.”
“Blessed na dem wey dey make peace, because dem go call dem God pikin dem.”
“Blessed na dem wey dem don persecute because of righteousness, because Kingdom of Heaven na dem own.”
“Blessed na una when people reproach una, persecute una, and talk all kinds of evil against una falsely, because of me.”
“Rejoice, and dey very glad, because una reward dey great for heaven. Because na so dem persecute di prophets wey come before una.”
“Una na di salt of di earth, but if di salt don lose im flavor, with wetin dem go take salt am? E no good for anything again, except to throw am out and make people tread am with dem feet.”
“Una na di light of di world. City wey dey on hill no fit hide.”
“Una no dey light lamp, put am under measuring basket, but on stand; and e dey shine on everybody wey dey inside di house.”
“Even so, make una light shine before men; so that dem go see una good works, and glorify una Papa God wey dey heaven.”
“No think say I come to destroy di law or di prophets. I no come to destroy, but to fulfill.”
“Because most certainly, I tell una, until heaven and earth pass away, even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke no go pass away from di law at all, until all things don accomplish.”

“Whoever den go break one of di least of dis commandments, and teach others to do so, dem go call am least for Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever go do and teach dem, dem go call am great for Kingdom of Heaven.”
“Because I tell una say unless una righteousness pass dat of di scribes and Pharisees, una no go enter Kingdom of Heaven at all.”
“Una don hear say dem talk to di ancient ones, ‘You no go murder;’ and ‘Whoever murder go dey in danger of di judgment.’”

“But I tell una, say everyone wey dey angry with im brother without cause go dey in danger of di judgment; and whoever talk say to im brother, ‘Raca!’ go dey in danger of di council; and whoever talk say, ‘You fool!’ go dey in danger of di fire of Gehenna.”
“So if you dey offer your gift for di altar, and for dat place you remember say your brother get something against you,”
“leave your gift for dat place before di altar, and go your way. First make peace with your brother, den come and offer your gift.”
“Agree with your adversary quick, while you dey with am for di way; so that di prosecutor no go hand you over to di judge, and di judge hand you over to di officer, and dem throw you inside prison.”
“Most certainly I tell you, you no go get out from dat place at all, until you don pay di last penny.”
“Una don hear say dem talk, ‘You no go commit adultery;’”
“but I tell una say everyone wey gaze at woman to lust after am don commit adultery with am already for im heart.”
“If your right eye dey make you stumble, pluck am out and throw am away from you. Because e better for you say one part of your body perish, than say dem throw your whole body into Gehenna.”
“If your right hand dey make you stumble, cut am off, and throw am away from you. Because e better for you say one part of your body perish, than say dem throw your whole body into Gehenna.”
“Dem talk too say, ‘Whoever send im wife away, make e give am certificate of divorce,’”
“but I tell una say whoever send im wife away, except for cause of sexual immorality, dey make am adulteress; and whoever marry di one wey dem send away dey commit adultery.”
“Again una don hear say dem talk to di ancient ones, ‘You no go make false vows, but you go perform your vows to di Lord,’”
“but I tell una, no swear at all: no by heaven, because na God throne;”
“and no by di earth, because na di footstool for im feet; and no by Jerusalem, because na di city of di great King.”
“You no go swear by your head either, because you no fit make one hair white or black.”
“But make your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Anything wey pass dis na from di evil one.”
“Una don hear say dem talk, ‘Eye for eye, and tooth for tooth.’”
“But I tell una, no resist di one wey dey evil; but whoever slap you for your right cheek, turn di other one to am too.”
“If anybody sue you to take away your coat, make am take your cloak too.”
“Whoever force you to go one mile, go two with am.”
“Give to di one wey ask you, and no turn away di one wey want borrow from you.”
“Una don hear say dem talk, ‘You go love your neighbor, and hate your enemy.’”
“But I tell una, love una enemies, bless dem wey curse una, do good to dem wey hate una, and pray for dem wey mistreat una and persecute una,”
“so that una go be pikin dem of una Papa God wey dey heaven. Because e dey make im sun rise on di evil and di good, and dey send rain on di just and di unjust.”
“Because if una love dem wey love una, wetin reward una get? Di tax collectors no dey do di same too?”
“If una only greet una friends, wetin more una dey do pass others? Di tax collectors no dey do di same too?”
“So una go be perfect, just as una Papa God for heaven dey perfect.”
“Make una dey careful say una no do una charitable giving before men, to make dem see una, if no, una no go get reward from una Papa God wey dey heaven.”

“So when una do deeds of mercy, no blow trumpet before una self, as di hypocrites dey do for di synagogues and for di streets, so that dem go get glory from men. Most certainly I tell una, dem don receive dem reward.”
“But when una do deeds of mercy, no make una left hand know wetin una right hand dey do,”
“so that una deeds of mercy go dey for secret, den una Papa God wey dey see for secret go reward una openly.”

“When una dey pray, una no go be like di hypocrites, because dem love to stand and pray for di synagogues and for di corners of di streets, so that men go see dem. Most certainly I tell una, dem don receive dem reward.”
“But you, when you dey pray, enter your inner room, and shut your door, pray to your Papa God wey dey for secret, and your Papa God wey dey see for secret go reward you openly.”
“As una dey pray, no use vain repetitions, as di Gentiles dey do; because dem think say dem go dey heard because of dem plenty talking.”
“So no be like dem, because una Papa God know wetin una need before una ask am.”
“Pray like dis: ‘Our Papa God wey dey heaven, make your name dey holy.’”
“‘Make your Kingdom come. Make your will dey done for earth as e dey for heaven.’”
“‘Give us today our daily bread.’”
“‘Forgive us our debts, as we too dey forgive our debtors.’”
“‘No bring us enter temptation, but save us from di evil one. Because di Kingdom, di power, and di glory na your own forever. Amen.’”
“Because if una forgive men dem trespasses, una Papa God wey dey heaven go forgive una too.”
“But if una no forgive men dem trespasses, una Papa God no go forgive una trespasses too.”

“Moreover, when una dey fast, no be like di hypocrites, with sad faces. Because dem dey disfigure dem faces, so that men go see say dem dey fast. Most certainly I tell una, dem don receive dem reward.”
“But you, when you dey fast, anoint your head, and wash your face,”
“so that men no go see say you dey fast, but na your Papa God wey dey for secret, and your Papa God, wey dey see for secret, go reward you.”
“No lay up treasures for una self for di earth, wia moth and rust dey consume, and wia thieves dey break through and steal;”
“but lay up treasures for una self for heaven, wia moth and rust no dey consume, and wia thieves no dey break through and steal;”
“because wia your treasure dey, na for dat place your heart go dey too.”
“Di lamp of di body na di eye. If your eye dey healthy, your whole body go full of light.”
“But if your eye dey evil, your whole body go full of darkness. If di light wey dey inside you na darkness, how great di darkness dey!”
“Nobody fit serve two oga dem, because e go hate one and love di other; or e go hold to one and despise di other. Una no fit serve God and Mammon.”
“So I tell una, no dey anxious about una life: wetin una go eat, or wetin una go drink; and no dey anxious about una body, wetin una go wear. Life no dey pass food, and di body no dey pass clothing?”
“Look di birds of di sky, say dem no dey sow, and dem no dey reap, and dem no dey gather enter barns. Una Papa God wey dey heaven dey feed dem. Una no dey worth plenty pass dem?”
“Which one among una, by dey anxious, fit add one cubit to di measure of im life?”
“Why una dey anxious about clothing? Consider di lilies of di field, how dem dey grow. Dem no dey work hard, and dem no dey spin,”
“yet I tell una say even Solomon for all im glory no dress like one of dem.”
“But if God dey clothe di grass of di field so, wey dey exist today, and tomorrow dem go throw am into di oven, e no go clothe una more, una wey get small faith?”
“So no dey anxious, dey talk say, ‘Wetin we go eat?’, ‘Wetin we go drink?’ or, ‘Wetin we go wear?’”
“Because di Gentiles dey seek after all dis things; because una Papa God wey dey heaven know say una need all dis things.”
“But seek God Kingdom first, and im righteousness; and dem go give una all dis things too.”
“So no dey anxious about tomorrow, because tomorrow go dey anxious for imself. Each day own evil don enough.”
“No judge, so that dem no go judge una.”
“Because with whatever judgment una judge, dem go judge una; and with whatever measure una measure, dem go measure am to una.”
“Why you dey see di speck wey dey your brother eye, but you no dey consider di beam wey dey your own eye?”
“Or how you go talk say to your brother, ‘Make I remove di speck from your eye;’ and look, di beam dey your own eye?”
“You hypocrite! First remove di beam from your own eye, and den you go fit see clearly to remove di speck from your brother eye.”
“No give wetin holy to di dogs, and no throw your pearls before di pigs, so that dem no go trample dem under dem feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.”
“Ask, and dem go give you. Seek, and you go find. Knock, and dem go open am for you.”
“Because everyone wey ask dey receive. Di one wey seek dey find. To di one wey knock dem go open am.”
“Or who dey among una, wey, if im pikin ask am for bread, e go give am stone?”
“Or if e ask for fish, who go give am serpent?”
“If una den, wey dey evil, know how to give good gifts to una pikin dem, how plenty more una Papa God wey dey heaven go give good things to dem wey ask am!”
“So whatever una want make men do to una, una go also do to dem; because dis na di law and di prophets.”
“Enter by di narrow gate; because di gate wide and di way broad wey dey lead to destruction, and plenty people dey enter by am.”
“How narrow di gate dey, and di way wey dey lead to life dey restricted! Few people dey find am.”
“Beware of false prophets, wey dey come to una with sheep clothing, but inside dem na ravening wolves.”
“By dem fruits una go know dem. Men dey gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?”
“Even so, every good tree dey produce good fruit; but di corrupt tree dey produce evil fruit.”
“Good tree no fit produce evil fruit, and corrupt tree no fit produce good fruit.”
“Every tree wey no grow good fruit dem go cut am down, and throw am into di fire.”
“So, by dem fruits una go know dem.”
“No be everyone wey talk say to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ go enter Kingdom of Heaven; but di one wey do di will of my Papa God wey dey heaven.”
“Plenty people go tell me for dat day, ‘Lord, Lord, we no prophesy for your name, for your name cast out evil spirits, and for your name do plenty mighty works?’”
“Den I go tell dem, ‘I no ever know una. Depart from me, una wey dey work iniquity.’”
“So everyone wey hear dis my words, and do dem, I go liken am to wise man, wey build im house on rock.”
“Rain come down, floods come, and winds blow, and beat dat house; and e no fall, because dem build am on di rock.”
“Everyone wey hear dis my words, and no do dem go be like foolish man, wey build im house on di sand.”
“Rain come down, floods come, and winds blow, and beat dat house; and e fall — and great na im fall.”
E happen say, when Jesus finish to talk dis things, di multitudes dey astonished for im teaching,
because e dey teach dem with authority, and no be like di scribes.
When e come down from di mountain, great multitudes follow am.
Look, leper come to am and worship am, and talk say, “Lord, if you want am, you fit make me clean.”
Jesus stretch out im hand, and touch am, and talk say, “I want am. Make you clean.” Immediately im leprosy don clean.
Jesus talk say to am, “See say you no tell nobody, but go, show yourself to di priest, and offer di gift wey Moses command, as testimony to dem.”
When e enter Capernaum, centurion come to am, dey beg am,
and talk say, “Lord, my servant dey lie for house paralyzed, dey suffer terribly.”
Jesus talk say to am, “I go come and heal am.”
Di centurion answer, “Lord, I no worthy make you come under my roof. Just talk word, and my servant go dey healed.”
“Because me too na man under authority, wey get soldiers under me. I tell dis one, ‘Go!’ and e dey go; and to another, ‘Come!’ and e dey come; and to my servant, ‘Do dis,’ and e dey do am.”
When Jesus hear am, e marvel, and talk say to dem wey dey follow am, “Most certainly I tell una, I never find so great faith, even for Israel.”
“I tell una say plenty people go come from di east and di west, and go sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob for Kingdom of Heaven,”
“but dem go throw di pikin dem of di Kingdom out enter di outer darkness. Weeping and gnashing of teeth go dey for dat place.”
Jesus talk say to di centurion, “Go your way. Make am happen for you as you don believe.” Im servant heal for dat hour.
When Jesus come enter Peter house, e see im wife mama dey lie sick with fever.
E touch im hand, and di fever leave am. E get up, and serve am.
When evening come, dem bring plenty people wey get evil spirits to am. E cast out di spirits with word, and heal all wey sick;
so that wetin dem talk through Isaiah di prophet go dey fulfilled, wey talk say, “E take our infirmities, and carry our diseases.”
Now when Jesus see great multitudes around am, e give order to depart go di other side.
Scribe come, and talk say to am, “Teacher, I go follow you wherever you go.”
Jesus talk say to am, “Foxes get holes, and birds of di sky get nests, but Son of Man no get place to lay im head.”
Another of im disciples talk say to am, “Lord, allow me first to go bury my papa.”
But Jesus talk say to am, “Follow me, and leave di dead to bury dem own dead.”
When e enter boat, im disciples follow am.
Look, great tempest rise for di sea, so tay di waves cover di boat; but e dey sleep.
Dem come to am, and wake am up, and talk say, “Save us, Lord! We dey die!”
E talk say to dem, “Why una dey fear, una wey get small faith?” Den e get up, and rebuke di winds and di sea, and great calm come.
Di men marvel, and talk say, “Wetin kind man be dis, say even di winds and di sea dey obey am?”
When e reach di other side, enter di country of di Gergesenes, two people wey get evil spirits meet am for dat place, dey come out from di tombs, very fierce, so tay nobody fit pass dat way.
Look, dem cry out, and talk say, “Wetin we get to do with you, Jesus, God Pikin? You don come here to torment us before di time?”
Now one herd of plenty pigs dey feed far from dem.
Di evil spirits beg am, and talk say, “If you cast us out, allow us go enter di herd of pigs.”
E talk say to dem, “Go!” Dem come out, and enter di herd of pigs: and look, di whole herd of pigs rush down di cliff enter di sea, and die for di waters.
Dem wey dey feed dem run enter di city, and tell everything, including wetin happen to dem wey get evil spirits.
Look, all di city come out to meet Jesus. When dem see am, dem beg say make e leave dem borders.
